title: NOAA ENSO signal repaired against the July discussion
summary: The published ENSO record was refreshed against NOAA CPC's 9 July 2026 Diagnostic Discussion. The update preserved the signal's bounded climate-risk framing and recorded the next scheduled discussion date.
evidence_note: The official NOAA CPC discussion was checked on 21 July 2026; the dated discussion used by the signal was issued on 9 July 2026.
